instant.label: Instant
instant.desc: Cut — no animation, happens on one frame

overshoot.label: Overshoot
overshoot.desc: Goes past the final size, then settles back

takeaways.text: Range across the 7 apps; median 865 ms. Facebook's fly-out is the quickest (333 ms). Simple one-icon taps (Reddit, Instagram) take 400–500 ms. Bursts and picker apps that end in a button or badge pop (X, YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) take 850–1000 ms.

Facebook, Instagram, Reddit and X switch the label/count/color on the very first frame and play the animation on top. YouTube swaps to the filled icon at ~117 ms. LinkedIn and WhatsApp wait until the flying icon or closing menu finishes, showing the new reaction at 800 ms and 533 ms.
Most apps "pop" the chosen icon: it grows past full size and settles back to 100%. Overshoot peaks ranged from 108% (Facebook) to 153% (WhatsApp); 120% was the most common (YouTube, LinkedIn).
The shared rhythm: a quick ease-out launch (85–200 ms) followed by a slower ease-in-out settle. Nothing bounces more than twice.
In the three apps with a reaction picker (Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp) the chosen emoji travels toward where the reaction will live — the button, the count, or a badge on the message.

v1.style_desc: The picked emoji does a tiny pop, flies up and over in an arc toward the reaction count, and shrinks to nothing on the way. The tray drops away underneath it.
v1.zero: the tap on an emoji in the tray
v1.same_for_all: Yes — all six reactions (Love, Care, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry) use identical timing, the same arc height and land on the same spot, no matter which slot they start from.

steps.title: Tray drops away
steps.what: The tray and the other five emojis slide down ~15 pt and fade out. The unpicked emojis also shrink to 25%.

steps.title: Picked emoji pops
steps.what: Grows from 100% to 108%.

steps.title: Flies in an arc
steps.what: Rises ~85 pt (highest point at 117 ms), then curves down to the reaction-count area at the bottom-left of the post.

steps.title: Shrinks to nothing
steps.what: Shrinks from 108% to 0% while flying, so it vanishes as it lands.

steps.title: Button updates
steps.what: The Like button switches to the reaction's icon and colored name (e.g. red "Love"). The count text updates ~50 ms later. Both are instant.

v2.style: Squash → pop with tilt + ray burst
v2.style_desc: The outline thumb squashes down, then the filled thumb springs up bigger than normal while tipping back, holds for a beat and settles. A ring of short rays bursts outward behind it.
v2.zero: the tap on the Like button (the motion starts when the finger lifts)
v2.same_for_all: Yes — the feed card and the watch page matched to within one frame. Unlike and dislike have no animation (instant swap).

steps.title: Outline thumb squashes
steps.what: Shrinks from 100% to 32% and tilts 9°.

steps.title: Filled thumb pops up
steps.what: Swaps to the filled thumb and grows from 32% to 120%, tipping back ~12°.

steps.title: Holds big
steps.what: Stays at 120%.

steps.title: Settles
steps.what: Returns to 100% with a small wobble (tilts to −6°, then upright).

steps.title: Ray burst
steps.what: 10 rays (alternating long red #FF0033 and short pink #FF2893) shoot out to ~21 pt from the center, shrink into dots and fade.

v2.variant: On one comedy video the thumb briefly turned into a laughing emoji with circling dots before popping (no ray burst). YouTube appears to theme this by content.

v3.style_desc: The picked icon flies in a small arc down into the Like button and shrinks away. A beat later the button swaps to the new reaction and pops in slightly oversized.
v3.zero: the tap on a reaction in the tray
v3.same_for_all: Yes — all five reactions picked (Like, Celebrate, Support, Love, Insightful) follow the same timing.

steps.title: Tray disappears
steps.what: The tray and the unpicked icons vanish instantly. Only the picked icon stays.

steps.title: Icon flies to the Like button
steps.what: Arcs up ~36 pt, then down into the Like button (~74 pt below where it started), shrinking from 100% to 0%.

steps.title: Old button shrinks out
steps.what: The gray "Like" shrinks to 35% and fades.

steps.title: Short pause
steps.what: The button is empty for 67 ms.

steps.title: New reaction pops in
steps.what: The button now shows the reaction's icon, label and color. It grows from 0% to 120% and snaps back to 100%.

v4.style: Press squish → menu closes → badge double-bounce
v4.style_desc: The tapped emoji squishes like a button, the reaction bar and menu fold away, then the reaction badge pops onto the message with a playful double bounce.
v4.zero: the tap on an emoji in the reaction bar
v4.same_for_all: Yes — 👍, ❤️ and 😂 all matched within 1–2 frames. Removing a reaction skips the squish and the badge.
v4.icon_size: Reaction badge emoji: ~20 pt; bar emojis: ~36 pt

steps.title: Emoji squishes
steps.what: The tapped emoji presses down to 69% and springs back to 100%.

steps.title: Selection circle
steps.what: A 42 pt gray (#444) circle fades in behind the emoji.

steps.title: Menu closes
steps.what: The bar collapses toward the left, the menu shrinks into its corner, the message settles from 105% back to 100%, and the background un-dims.

steps.title: Badge double-bounces in
steps.what: The badge under the message grows 0% → 153% (by 150 ms) → 104% (233 ms) → 122% (333 ms) → 100% (467 ms).

v5.style_desc: The filled heart hops up out of the Like button, growing to twice its size with a little tilt, then drops softly back into place. No big heart over the photo in this recording.
v5.same_for_all: Yes — both likes matched to the frame. The heart's gradient color is different each time (orange→red, purple→magenta).

steps.title: Count +1
steps.what: The like count updates instantly.

steps.title: Heart jumps out
steps.what: The filled heart rises 83 pt above the button, grows from 100% to 203% and fades in. It tilts 18° to the left and is upright again by the top.

steps.title: Drops back in
steps.what: Falls back into the button and shrinks to 100%. Soft landing — no bounce.

steps.title: Button icon reacts
steps.what: The outline heart in the button squishes to 71%, grows to 106% and fades out underneath the flying heart.

v5.variant: About 850 ms after the like, the gradient blends to the standard Instagram red (#FE0028). This was cut off by the next tap, so its length (~300 ms) is a rough estimate.

v6.style_desc: The arrow fills orange and does a single quick hop up, dips just below its resting spot and settles. No scaling, no particles.
v6.same_for_all: Yes — both upvotes matched frame for frame. Downvote is the mirror image: purple (#6A5BFE), only 6 pt down, ~383 ms. Removing a vote is instant.

steps.title: Fill + score change
steps.what: The arrow fills solid orange (#FF4500), and the score goes +1 and turns dark orange — instantly.

steps.title: Hops up
steps.what: Moves up 14 pt.

steps.title: Drops a little too far
steps.what: Comes down to ~3 pt below its resting spot.

steps.title: Settles
steps.what: Back to its resting spot.

v7.style_desc: The classic Twitter heart: a pink dot swells into a circle that hollows out into a ring, the heart pops up from inside it, and a ring of tiny colored dots sprays outward.
v7.same_for_all: Yes — all three likes had identical timing (the feed version is just smaller). Unliking has no burst: the gray outline jumps to ~158%, then shrinks back over ~300 ms.
v7.icon_size: Heart icon: ~19 pt; burst circle: 28 pt

steps.title: Count +1, turns pink
steps.what: The count updates and turns pink (#F91880) instantly.

steps.title: Dot swells into a circle
steps.what: A tiny dot grows into a 28 pt circle, shifting from crimson (#DF2A67) to lavender (#CC8EF4).

steps.title: Circle hollows into a ring
steps.what: The center opens up until it's a thin ring, then it's gone.

steps.title: Heart pops in
steps.what: The filled pink heart grows from 16% to 98% inside the ring.

steps.title: Heart settles
steps.what: Gently dips to 89% (around 520–630 ms) and eases back to 100%.

steps.title: Particles spray out
steps.what: 14 small dots in 7 pairs (evenly spaced around the heart) fly out from 15 to 24 pt, shrinking and fading.
